notes.title: Graphic and Feature update
notes.content:
Major Update
===========

Release 1.1.0
=============

Changes
-------
Added completely new graphics for HI-LO.
Added top prize of 50 to Bar None.
Added completely new graphics for Pipe Dream.
Made Ball Drop faster.
Made Blob Chase faster.
Extended both CashPot and NudgePot maximums to 99.
Made Diddy Diddler faster.
Blob Chase now gives 30, 40 or 50 for winning the race.
Added completely new graphics for ZigZag.
Moved Prize Board from main screen. (Now accessible by holding down the 'P' Key).
Added Lives Display to Diddy Diddler.
Added a "Lowest Score" to the High Score Table! ;)

Added a BRAND NEW Skill Feature called "BOING" , which is accessed by filling the matrix on the main screen.

We've also added a "Random Repeat" to several of the features, which could repeat more than once!!!.

Bug Fixes
---------
Fixed Bug that exits the game when resetting the High Score table.

Fixed new Bug that stopped Fruit Bowl paying out.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.2 (Mar 26th 2022)
notes.content:
Patch to version 1.0.2 - Small Graphical Update

New Reel Graphics.
Numbers instead of Jewels on the Reels, and a small graphical change to the Main Glass to reflect that change.

No new or outstanding bugs to fix.
